question.text: Using the continuous compounding formula F = S × e^((r-rf)×t), given S = 84, r (INR) = 7%, rf (USD) = 5%, t = 0.25 years, what is F? (e^0.005 = 1.005013)

explanation.text: The Logic: F = 84 × e^((0.07-0.05)×0.25) = 84 × e^0.005 = 84 × 1.005013 = 84.4211 ≈ 84.42. The Trap: Using simple compounding: F = 84 × 1.0175/1.0125 = 84.417, very close but not identical to continuous compounding. Cross-Exam Context: The theoretical price formula uses continuous compounding — specified in contract specifications. Exam Tip: For exam purposes, e^x ≈ 1+x for small x. So e^0.005 ≈ 1.005, giving F ≈ 84 × 1.005 = 84.42.
